approveNewTeeVersion(bytes32).details: This function increments the version number automatically based on the current history

params.newMrAggregated: - The MR_AGGREGATED bytes of the new TEE version

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

getSignerAtIndex(uint256).details: each signer id is NOT fixed, it can change over time, be removed, readded, etc.

returns._0: true if the bootstrap is complete, false otherwise

isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes[]).details: Duplicate detection is optimized when signatures are sorted by signer address (ascending)Behavior notes:      - Returns false if threshold is 0 (not yet configured)      - Returns false if fewer signatures provided than threshold      - Invalid/malformed signatures are skipped (not counted, don't cause failure)      - If all signatures are invalid/malformed, returns false (no valid signatures can reach the threshold)      - Duplicate signers cause immediate rejection (returns false)      - Valid signatures from non-authorized addresses are skipped      - Processing stops early once threshold is reached (remaining signatures ignored)Gas considerations:      - O(n) when signatures are sorted by signer address (ascending) - recommended      - O(n²) worst case when signatures are in reverse order (fallback duplicate detection)      - Callers should provide signatures in ascending signer address order for optimal gas usage

params.digest: The message digest (hash) that was signed

returns._0: bool True if at least `threshold` unique authorized signers signed the digest

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

returns._0: reportDataSigner - The signing address of the report data signer
returns._1: reportMrAggregated - The MR_AGGREGATED bytes from the report

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

reset().details: This function performs a destructive operation and should be used carefully. In particular: 1) This function will remove all signers and reset the network pubkey and approved TEE versions, requiring a full bootstrap to restore normal operation. 2) The contract effectively enters a maintenance mode where any operations that depend on signers or the network key will fail until re-bootstrap is completed. 3) This function is intended to be called only as part of a coordinated key rotation or recovery process, with off-chain components updated accordingly.This function is only callable by the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.quote: - The quote from the new covalidator that contains the current MR_AGGREGATED and the eoa address of the new party in the report data

params.signature: - The EIP712 signature of the bootstrap result by the TDX EOA

params.signature: - The EIP712 signature of the upgrade result by the TDX EOA

approveNewTeeVersion(bytes32).notice: Approves a new TEE version as PENDING and updates the TEEVersionHistory. The new TEE version can be activated by calling verifyBootstrapResult or activateNewTEEVersion.

computeMrAggregated(bytes,bytes,bytes,by.notice: Computes the MR_AGGREGATED from the TD10 report body. It is defined as: as KECCAK256(abi.encode(MRTD, RTMR0, RTMR1, RTMR2))

isBootstrapComplete().notice: Checks if the bootstrap is complete.

isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes[]).notice: Verifies that a digest has been signed by at least `threshold` authorized signers

parseReport((bytes16,bytes,bytes,bytes8,.notice: Parses the TD10 report to extract the report data and MR_AGGREGATED

parseTd10ReportBody(bytes).notice: From https://github.com/automata-network/automata-dcap-attestation/blob/evm-v1.0.0/evm/contracts/verifiers/V4QuoteVerifier.sol#L309Parses the TD10 report body from the raw quote

reset().notice: Resets the contract state to the initial state.

uploadCollateral((string,bytes),(string,.notice: Uploads the collateral to the contract

verifyAddNodeResult(bytes32,(bytes),byte.notice: Verifies the add node result, and adds the new EOA signer to the contract state.

verifyBootstrapResult((bytes),bytes,byte.notice: Wrapper around activateNewTEEVersion which verifies the bootstrap result and marks the new TEE version as active

verifyUpgradeResult(bytes32,(bytes),byte.notice: Verifies the upgrade result for a single EOA. This function does not modify any contract state. It simply serves as an on-chain proof that each TDX has been updated to the newest MR_AGGREGATED.
